title: A2A Protocol Documented Issues
description: Documented inconsistencies, violations, and known issues in the protocol implementation

syntax_errors.description: build_llm_cache_payload function parameters expect str but receive str | dict[Any, Any]
syntax_errors.impact: Type safety violations in LLM cache payload construction
syntax_errors.resolution: Update function signature to handle union types or add type guards
syntax_errors.evidence: LSP error diagnostics confirm type mismatches

syntax_errors.description: Execute commands contain only message strings instead of expected form or tool action keys
syntax_errors.impact: Protocol violation - clients expect structured execute commands, not plain messages
syntax_errors.resolution: Update server responses to use proper execute command format or move messages to ServerMessage.message field

syntax_errors.impact: Audit script cannot run, preventing session storage validation
syntax_errors.resolution: Either create the missing module or update import to use existing utility

field_confusion_errors.description: Server using ServerMessage.message for executable content instead of ServerMessage.execute
field_confusion_errors.impact: Client may not execute intended server commands
field_confusion_errors.resolution: Reserve ServerMessage.message for user display, ServerMessage.execute for client actions

missing_documentation.resolution: Add comprehensive field documentation with usage examples

redundancy_issues.description: Similar fields defined across different interfaces (e.g., action field in ContextBlock vs ExecutionContext)
redundancy_issues.resolution: Consolidate common fields into shared base interfaces

recommended_actions.action: Fix type mismatches in LLM cache functions
Update session response files to use proper execute command format
Create missing recursive-directory-walker module or update imports

testing_gaps.impact: Invalid data may pass through system undetected
testing_gaps.resolution: Implement and test protocol validators for all message types
Update script paths or create expected directory structure
